jurisdiction.name: Dominica
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Dominica has published no AI-specific law, strategy, guideline or regulator guidance, and has not enacted a data protection law. Its digital agenda is led by the Ministry of Public Works, Public Utilities and Digital Economy, whose National Digital Transformation Strategy, prepared with UNDP support, has not been published.
lead_institutions: Ministry of Public Works, Public Utilities and Digital Economy
narrative.review_notes: This review was carried out on 12 October 2026. The government portal, ministry sites and the telecoms regulator were searched and none has published an AI document. The online laws database stops at 2009 and there is no searchable online gazette. The digital transformation strategy and a data protection bill are tracked as leads.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: The official laws database, the government portal and information service, the digital economy ministry, other ministries and regulators were searched at national level. No qualifying AI-governance document was found in any category. The laws database ends in 2009 and there is no searchable official gazette online, so the National Digital Transformation Strategy and the status of the Data Protection Bill remain to be checked.

leads.title: National Digital Transformation Strategy (Dominica)
leads.issuing_authority: Ministry of Public Works, Public Utilities and Digital Economy
leads.note: Developed with UNDP support since 2021 (stakeholder workshops, digital readiness assessment, public survey) and referred to by the Minister for the Digital Economy in Government Information Service news as a road map for digital transformation. No published strategy text was found on publicworks.gov.dm, dominica.gov.dm or news.gov.dm as of 12 October 2026, so whether it contains an AI pillar cannot be checked. Record under strategy if published with AI content.

leads.title: Data Protection Bill (Dominica)
leads.issuing_authority: Government of the Commonwealth of Dominica
leads.note: Dominica has no enacted comprehensive data protection law. A Data Protection Bill was announced by government in 2014 for 2015 and an OECS harmonised data protection model is in development, but no bill text or act was found on official Dominica sites (the online laws database covers only to 2009; the House of Assembly site publishes no bills). Record under data-privacy if enacted.
